title: server cat
description: You can change the messages you send in the server chat, see the description for details.
body:
服务器猫猫是一个服务器模组，但是它同时兼任联机（只需要主机添加就可以了）
它可以让你在服务器发消息的时候在句末添加一个“喵”，使你的服务器成员都变成可爱猫猫（坏笑）

添加指令：
“/miaomiao add (玩家加入服务器的欢迎词) (玩家退出服务器的告别词)”

至于其他的命令就是清除和显示目前设置的词，正常使用不用在意

**⚠️注意！** “()”只是方便理解和区分用的，正常输入指令不用带


本模组后续会考虑加入更多版本和模组加载器。至于为什么neoforge和forge要信雅互联，可能是因为我懒所以只作了fabric吧（笑）

具体可以看演示视频：https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1T6Te6bEES/

Server Cat is a server mod, but it also doubles as a multiplayer add-on (you just need to add it to the host).
It lets you add a '喵' at the end of messages you send on the server.

Add command: 
/miaomiao add (welcome message for when a player joins the server) (farewell message for when a player leaves the server)
As for the other commands, they are just to clear or display the current settings, no need to worry about them during normal use.

**⚠️Note!**  The “()” are just for easier understanding and distinction, you don’t need to include them when typing the command normally.



Summary:
Super useful，But the mod tailored for Chinese servers and players,If non-Chinese players use it, the chat bar may act weird (non-Chinese players should be careful when downloading and installing)
